analysis_checklist.evidence: Market read sourced from TradingView MCP only unless explicit external context was requested.
Monthly/Weekly/Daily or an explicitly compressed stack was checked before lower-timeframe execution.
Highest-degree macro count was attempted before lower-timeframe micro counts.
Each timeframe was fitted or visible range was explicitly set before interpretation.
Primary HEW count defines direction, degree, active wave, subwaves, and confidence.
Subwaves inside macro Waves 1, 3, and 5 were mapped when visible, or missing evidence was stated.
Model 1, Model 2, Model 3, or unavailable/recount reason was recorded.
Alternate count has activation, invalidation, and different next implication.
Wave 3 was checked against the 176.4% minimum floor from Wave 2.
C of 3 was compared against A of 3 when Wave 3 internals were visible.
Wave 2, B of 3, Wave 4, and B of 5 support/resistance rules were checked as applicable.
Wave-B invalidation ladder was documented with a violation standard.
Wave 2 and Wave 4 were compared for depth, duration, and complexity.
Active correction type was identified or missing evidence was stated.
Projection follows the highest-probability macro-following impulsive or complex corrective path; targets were clustered or lack of confluence was recorded.
Hard invalidation level breaks a rule and is separated from flip level.
Flip level changes posture without necessarily invalidating the count.
Location, trigger, invalidation, reward, and timeframe alignment were scored.
Castaway model was selected; Model 6 blocks trade language.
Important measurements are traceable with pass/fail conclusions.
Strongest countercase and proof needed were written before final posture.
